name: audio-ui
description: The audio/ui skill for Claude Code: audio interfaces on the web, from a knob to a DAW.

plugins.name: audio-ui
plugins.description: Builds audio interfaces with audio/ui, in three skills: audio-ui picks, installs and wires the components, web-audio gets sound out without clicks and keeps live meters and playheads out of React state, and design styles the headless primitives into retro hardware, minimal or modern panels.
